story.title: Cowboys, Salvation Army to illuminate AT&T Stadium red in celebration of 30-year partnership
story.summary: Since joining forces, the Cowboys and The Salvation Army have helped raise more than $3.4 billion through their partnership. November 23, 2026 / 5:16 PM CST / CBS Texas The Dallas Cowboys and The Salvation Army will mark a major milestone in their 30-year partnership with a first-of-its-kind lighting ceremony at AT&T Stadium on Monday, kicking off Thanksgiving week and celebrating the annual Red Kettle Campaign. Four generations of the Gene and Jerry Jones family will gather to illuminate AT&T Stadium's exterior in red, recognizing three decades of working together and the organizations' shared commitment to helping individuals and families in need. Since joining forces, the Cowboys and The Salvation Army have helped raise more than $3.4 billion through their partnership.
